# Independent automation review — prepared, inactive

Reviewed the staged scheduler, trusted helpers, queue, deployment map and documentation on 2026-10-02. Suitable for review as a **disabled automation PR**. No critical issue remains in the inspected control plane. This review does not establish activation or fresh-runner readiness.

Validation: **36 offline tests passed** (9 round-control, 22 runtime guards, 5 independent untrusted-artifact tests). YAML parsed; all 8 research-workflow shell blocks passed `bash -n`; all 3 embedded Python blocks compiled. The workflow author also reports both workflows passed checksum-verified official actionlint 1.7.12. No model API call, remote publication, scheduler activation or secret value was used in this review.

The actual guards cover canonical repository/default branch, explicit separate smoke/research enablement, exact root model/effort, one smoke per campaign, no paid reruns, complete paginated metadata, maximum seven-day campaign, four daily and twelve total conservative invocation limits, single-workflow concurrency, pending-PR pause, closed task/source duplicate suppression, and fail-stop after a prior failed or rerun research invocation. A renewed campaign requires a diagnosed correction. Source and scheduler commits are distinct; preflight verifies the pinned science checkout and reviewed junction/static-bridge input digests before paid work. The first task advances to massive de Sitter rho/Q in a common reference prescription rather than repeating the completed junction derivation.

The model runner has read permissions and uses the pinned official Action's proxy, `:workspace` network restrictions and Linux `drop-sudo` protections. Its thread limit is one spawned reviewer plus the root, with requested model/effort defaults set for both. Retention uses immutable paths, isolated Python and trusted scheduler code. A fresh publisher obtains write permissions, reconstructs the expected context, checks narrow file scope/provenance/hashes and never executes submitted model scripts; the latter property has an executed sentinel test. A separate fresh read-only receipt job observes actual job/model-step failures. No job merges main or publishes a DOI.

Limits remain explicit: the three-evaluation bound validates the reported evaluation manifest, not every shell command; hashes and schema cannot establish truthful execution, unchanged prospective registration, mathematical correctness or independent peer review. Time/invocation limits are not an exact token/dollar cap. GitHub logs retain invocation accounting if receipt/artifact creation itself fails. Existing negative science outcomes remain preserved, and dependent tasks require passing reviewed ledger records.

Activation is still blocked by an untested exact-model account request, unverified GitHub Actions settings/secrets/PR permissions and fresh-runner execution. Native scheduler persistence remains unverified. Configure credentials securely, verify the bounded smoke request and repository permissions, and review the disabled template before enabling a finite campaign.
